facts.label: Cheats
facts.value: Cheats disable trophies — do not use them

facts.label: Mission replay
facts.value: None — keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter (15 save slots)

missables.detail: One meditation exists only in Chapter 1, at Jason's house. After the Down to Earth mission, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept. It is still unclear whether the trophy needs it, so do it to be safe. Everything else in the game can still be earned in free-roam after the story.
missables.name: Positive Mental Attitude

stages.name: Play the story — Chapters 1 to 5
steps: Play the story in order: Gone Fishing, then Chapters 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5, finishing with the final mission.
Do the Chapter 1 meditation while you can — it is the one thing that can be missed (see Missables).
Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter; there is no mission replay.
As you travel, scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app and study new animals with the binoculars — both count toward 100% later.
Try activities as they appear (fishing, golf, shooting ranges, races) and do optional missions when they show up; more than 100 exist and you only need 100 for the checklist.

stages.name: The 100% Completion checklist
steps: After the story, open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion. Everything on it is still doable in free-roam.
Finish any 100 optional missions, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, and 15 of 18 meditations.
Scan 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles and study 100 of the 255 animals.
Clear every robbery: all 8 large bank vaults, all 39 illegal gang operations, and every shooting range, drone race and Bret quest.
This stage pops A Long Road (gold) and, on the way, Cunning Stunts, One Last Thing, Maximum Withdrawal, Pest Control and most collectibles.
stages.trophies: A Long Road, plus most of the rest

stages.name: Strangers & Freaks and cleanup
steps: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks strands — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count.
Finish the five character questlines if any are left: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone.
Sweep up the one-off feats: the UFO, the blue Banshee showroom smash, the Ocean Beach cocktail, the Payday Loans re-robbery, and the bike kicks for Ten Pin.
Tick off the money trophies (launder $250,000 of marked bills, spend $100,000, buy all 8 garages, register 10 vehicles).
When the last trophy pops, Vice Got a Price! — the platinum — follows at once.
stages.trophies: The last few, then the platinum
